title: My Favourite Comic
text:
Tom reads a comic strip every day. The comic has a funny dog. The dog is called Max. Max likes to eat pizza.

Today, Tom reads a new comic. In the first box, Max is sleeping. In the last box, Max wakes up and laughs. Tom laughs too.

questions.text: What is the name of the dog?
What does Max do in the first box?
How does Tom feel at the end of the story?
Why does Tom read a comic strip every day?
options: He is studying for a test

vocabulary.definition: a story told in pictures in boxes, often with funny words
one of the squares with a picture in a comic strip
makes a sound with its voice because something is funny

paragraph_translations: Tom lee una tira cómica todos los días. El cómic tiene un perro divertido. El perro se llama Max. A Max le gusta comer pizza.
Hoy, Tom lee un cómic nuevo. En la primera viñeta, Max está durmiendo. En la última viñeta, Max se despierta y se ríe. Tom también se ríe.
